scientific_integrity: All stated universal claims are supported by analytic arguments; executable numerical checks are corroborative, not substitutes for proof. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Static worst-gradient mean alignment for gradient-independent one-dimensional directions, real SPD metric. No high-probability guarantee, nonlinear convergence theorem or higher-dimensional subspace result; the planar power-family classification is two-dimensional only. Historical overlap in classical E-optimal design is an unresolved priority risk.
title: Trace-optimal direction sampling for ellipsoidal one-dimensional alignment
